one_liner: Mailchimp Marketing API v3 is a broad REST API with self-serve API keys and OAuth 2 on a free account; only community MCP servers exist for the API.
auth_notes: OAuth 2 authorization code flow with non-expiring tokens (no refresh). Apps are registered self-serve under Registered Apps. API keys and OAuth tokens can be sent as Bearer or as the HTTP Basic password. The data center prefix (dc) must be resolved per account.
access_notes: A free Mailchimp account can generate an API key and register an OAuth app. What the API can do depends on the plan level. Listing in the Marketplace as an integration partner requires 25+ active users, but that is not needed to build.
blocker_notes: Some features depend on the plan tier, for example the Templates API is read-only on free plans. This does not block a toolkit.
